sources.finding: Supplier specifies RAL 5015 blue for Grade 100.
Supplier example specifies red RAL 3020 / yellow RAL 1003. KINSTON uses RAL 2004 orange per user instruction.

greenSource: Requested KINSTON colour option; no green RAL code inferred from supplier.
